answer: Every claim climbs the copper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zephyr re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the vine is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit.
